soal.question_en: How does poor sorting in sandstone affect reservoir permeability?

soal.question_en: Which of the following statements best describes the main difference between clastic and carbonate reservoir rocks?
options_en: Clastic rocks are formed by chemical precipitation, while carbonates are from mechanical fragments.
Clastic rocks generally consist of siliciclastic fragments, while carbonates are dominated by calcite or dolomite minerals.
Porosity in clastic rocks is always higher than in carbonate rocks.

Reduction of grain size during lithification.

soal.question: Mengapa sortasi (pemilahan) butiran sangat penting dalam menentukan kualitas reservoar klastik?

options_en: Good sorting ensures more uniform pore sizes and generally higher permeability.
Sorting has no effect on effective porosity.

soal.correct_option_en: Good sorting ensures more uniform pore sizes and generally higher permeability.

Batuan mengalami proses pelarutan kimia yang sangat intens.
Batuan belum mengalami banyak transportasi atau abrasi.
Batuan berasal dari lingkungan pengendapan laut dalam.

options_en: The rock has undergone very long transportation.
The rock has undergone intense chemical dissolution.
The rock has not undergone much transportation or abrasion.
The rock originated from a deep-sea depositional environment.
soal.correct_option_en: The rock has not undergone much transportation or abrasion.

Tidak memberikan pengaruh apapun terhadap aliran fluida.
soal.correct_option: Mengurangi porositas dan permeabilitas dengan menyumbat pori-pori.

Has no effect on fluid flow.
Changes the chemical properties of crude oil.
soal.correct_option_en: Reduces porosity and permeability by clogging pores.

options_en: Prevent further hydrocarbon migration to keep it trapped
Act as the primary source for gas generation
Provide pore space for oil accumulation

options_en: Lateral changes in porosity and permeability
correct_option_en: Lateral changes in porosity and permeability

soal.question: Apa istilah untuk kedalaman di mana gas, minyak, dan air bertemu dalam sebuah reservoir?

soal.question: Dalam konteks sistem hidrokarbon, apakah batuan reservoir wajib memiliki porositas dan permeabilitas yang baik?
options: Ya, karena diperlukan untuk menyimpan dan mengalirkan hidrokarbon
Tidak, yang terpenting adalah batuan harus sangat keras
Tidak, permeabilitas rendah justru lebih baik untuk menyimpan minyak

soal.question_en: In the context of a hydrocarbon system, must reservoir rock have good porosity and permeability?
options_en: Yes, because it is needed to store and flow hydrocarbons
No, the most important thing is for the rock to be very hard
